title: New Customer has the Sales Representative field too
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has two sales representatives, and you add a brand-new customer.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open New Customer.
  2. Fill in the required customer details.
  3. Pick {Sales-rep-A} in Sales Representative.
  4. Save the customer.
  5. Open the new customer's page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Customer window shows a Sales Representative field with the + beside it.
  • Step 2: the required fields are filled in.
  • Step 3: the field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 4: the customer is created.
  • Step 5: the page shows "Sales Representative" {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • Release day: “New: the New Customer window has a Sales Representative field (S4-R1). Before, a representative could only be set from Edit Customer.”
